evidence.quote: If you wish to apply to one of our English language programmes, please follow the guidelines below.
a demonstrated proficiency in English: the requested level of English proficiency is B2 (intermediate)
Application period for the fall semester of the academic year 2026-2027: 1 January -15 May 2026 in Dream Apply
The process of Application at the University of Szeged happens via an online application platform called the DreamApply.

name.fr: Certificat médical général de bonne santé

value.quotedAs: recent medical certificate of satisfactory general health status (General Medical Certificate)

evidence.quote: Application requirements: copy of passport recent medical certificate of satisfactory general health status (General Medical Certificate) high school diploma minimum of B2-intermediate level knowledge in English language

the requested level of English proficiency is B2 (intermediate) according to the Common European Framework Reference (CEFR); the certificate must be an international language exam (TELC B2, ECL B2, TOEFL iBT test score of 72, or RPDT score 72; Cambridge First Certificate "B"; IELTS score of 5.5 at least, LanguageCert B2 level)

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée oral (entretien Skype ou examen oral à Szeged) est requis; préparez votre motivation, vos bases en mathématiques et en informatique.
note.en: An oral entrance examination (Skype interview or oral exam in Szeged) is required; prepare your motivation, maths and computer science background.

evidence.quote: decision of acceptance can be made based on the documents submitted and a Skype interview; alternatively, an oral examination can be arranged in Szeged

notes: Tuition is stated as 3200 Euro/semester; the page also mentions an application fee of 79 Euro and entrance exam fee of 100 Euro (non-refundable), but these are not the tuition. Documents were taken from the 'Application requirements' list on the programme page. The programme page mentions Dream Apply as the channel; the Study Application Platform is DreamApply, which is university-direct for Hungary.
